读者朋友们，你们好！
Hello Reader系列丛书会让你在阅读过程中不知不觉地培养起英语语感，扩大词汇量，开阔眼界。下面的建议将会令你的阅读事半功倍：
● 阅读前先看看封面的图画，猜猜这本书会讲什么故事。
● 阅读时碰到不认识的单词，先猜猜它的发音和意思。
● 将默读和朗读结合起来。
● 阅读后把自己喜欢和感兴趣的单词抄录下来，反复朗读。
● 和家人、朋友一起分角色朗读故事。
● 经常和家人、朋友一起谈论故事中有趣的人和事。

page_text_en:
Dear readers, hello!
Hello Reader series will help you unconsciously develop your English sense, expand your vocabulary, and broaden your horizons during reading. The following suggestions will make your reading twice as effective:
● Before reading, look at the cover illustration and guess what story the book will tell.
● When you encounter unfamiliar words during reading, try to guess their pronunciation and meaning first.
● Combine silent reading with aloud reading.
● After reading, copy down the words you like or are interested in, and read them repeatedly.
● Read the story aloud with family and friends, taking on different roles.
● Often talk with family and friends about the interesting characters and events in the story.
